Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a logical error in its reasoning process by attempting to derive a single definitive answer ("1945") from multiple valid findings (1944 and 1945) using an arbitrary and unsupported method. The Planner stated it would use a "representative-year tie-break (average of the candidate years rounded up)" to yield 1945. This is a hallucinated rule; averaging 1944 and 1945 yields 1944.5, which rounds to 1945, but this mathematical manipulation is irrelevant to the factual question of "What year did they star in a film?" since there are two distinct years. The Planner incorrectly prioritized a single year over reporting the accurate set of years found, leading to a misleading conclusion that implies only one year fits the criteria when the evidence clearly shows two.
